授業概要
The draft syllabus for this class is attached to this page. This class is designed as a general introduction to problems and themes relating to 'Education and Development in Asia'. It features interviews with scholars specialising in various aspects of education in contemporary Asia, as well as related readings. Students will listen to the relevant interviews before class each week and read the related readings. In class, we will then discuss.
